pages.text: Sends a DELETE request: removes something on the server.$(br2)Some APIs expect data with it, most don't.

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)$(1)data$() STRING: the data sent with the request, in UTF-8 (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the raw data of the answer
$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer
$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_DELETE$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/timers/3" ;$(br)  RESULT status status$()
